verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents interacting with a page after scraping, including clicking and filling forms. It also offers managed browser sessions for interactive workflows, which partly addresses getting past form walls. Nothing in the pack shows automatic CAPTCHA solving or login/authentication handling on target sites, and the agent's autonomous use of these interactions to clear walls is only implied. Missing for 10: documented CAPTCHA bypass/solving, documented login/session-credential handling for gated sites, evidence that the agent clears walls autonomously, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically get past a CAPTCHA, login, or form wall without my manual intervention

citations.quote: Scrape a page, then keep working with it: click, fill forms, extract dynamic content, or navigate deeper.
